expert.text: Industrial robot installations reached 542,000 units in 2024, more than double 10 years earlier; China took 54% (295,000 units).

Leaders should prioritize mature capabilities (visual perception, dexterous manipulation) and architect for upgradeability; software-defined approaches can cut setup and reengineering costs by up to 50%.

lens.eng: Pilot vision-guided automation where tasks are repetitive and well defined.
